title: Jacob's New Dress
author: Sarah Hoffman
current_text: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Schools pulled Jacob's New Dress from its first-grade reading selection after a teacher reportedly complained; Superintendent Ann Clark cited “concerns” about the book, and the district said it would use Red the Crayon instead.

sources.quote:
CMS quickly wrote state leaders a letter telling them after their reaction and a re-evaluation on the district's part - "Jacob's New Dress" will not be used.
First graders will now use the book "Red the Crayon" to teach against anti-bully and harassment behavior.
sources.title: CMS backs away from using book about a boy in a dress for first graders

sources.quote: “Jacob’s New Dress" was initially picked to be a part of first graders' reading selection in Charlotte Mecklenburg Schools. But it was pulled after a teacher reportedly complained. Superintendent Ann Clark issued a vague statement citing “concerns” about the book.
sources.title: Authors Of 'Jacob's New Dress' Weigh In On CMS Decision To Pull Book | WFAE 90.7 - Charlotte's NPR News Source
